notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1.3

A smaller update regarding gameplay changes:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]

[*] Adjusted characters' Walkable Floor Angle to decrease the difficulty of the twister platforms (second level - rotating rocks) and prevent "slipping" too soon when jumping from edges.
[*] Adjusted the rotation speed of rotating tiles/barrels inside the sewers (second level) to prevent the character from being pushed through collisions and to decrease difficulty.
[*] Adjusted the duration of the speed-buff (fairy dust mechanic).
[*] Mushroom effects (inverted controls): Keyboard & Mouse input now only invert one axis instead of both. This change decreases difficulty and aligns the behavior with controller inputs.
[*] Items in the 4th level (Space Lab) meant for your inventory can only be collected, not picked up anymore.
[*] Made all menus fully navigable using a controller.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Added more story details. 
[*] Made various smaller adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.2
notes.content:
Fellow Degenerates!

We’re thrilled to present a complete overhaul of the UI, navigation, and control systems! Alongside major structural changes to the game’s backbone, we've made a host of smaller improvements. The game should now fully support controller input!

[b]General[/b]
[list]

[*] Overhauled the Settings Menu 
[*] Added functionality to the Main Menu
[*] Introduced new settings options. 
[*] Added key-binding options for both M&K and controller.
[*] Made all menus fully navigable by controller.
[*] Added features like V-Sync, FPS display, timer display, proper resolution scaling, and more.
[*] Updated visuals for the Main and Pause UI to better indicate when buttons are selected.
[*] Reworked the “Fairy Dust” mechanic in the Twister Level (second level) & added a tutorial.
[*] Adjusted the final sequence in the Space Lab level (4th level) to clearly indicate that the player is inside the rocket.
[*] Added additional audio effects for mechanics and sequences.
[*] Replaced some meshes and textures (e.g., sewer pipes in the second level) to align with other assets. 
[*] Renamed the “Play” button in the Main Menu to “New Game” to clarify that it will delete your progress and start fresh. The “Continue” button lets you pick up where you left off.
[*] Improved performance on the pee-particle-system
[*] Decreased difficulty related to some jumping passages
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed rotating pipes in the Sewers (second level) so they now work as intended. Previously, they rotated based on FPS rather than delta time, making it nearly impossible to pass for players with FPS over 110.
[*] Resolved an issue with the Pick-Up Tutorial in the 4th level, which now won’t play during the starting sequence.
[*] Corrected typos in subtitles.
[*] All tutorials and FALA's dialog can now be interacted with via the controller without causing a deadlock.
[*] Two interactable wall sections in the bug labyrinth were not behaving as intended (required double interaction).
[*] Adjusted LODs of some meshes to ensure they render correctly at low graphic settings.
[/list]

And a lot more minor bug fixes and changes not worth mentioning!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Hans-Enjoyers!
With a bit of delay, here are the patch notes for version 1.0.0.1:

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new guide system (F.A.L.A.) for the 4th Level (Space Lab) to assist players struggling with the mechanics.
[*] Added visual clues to levels to better convey the story or highlight mechanics.
[*] Lowered the volume of the Twister-Level (Second Level) soundtrack to match other level audio tracks.
[*] Updated subtitles to display according to the dialog rather than as one long sentence.
[*] Implemented a recovery system for items pushed out of the 4th level.
[*] Added a “Quit” button to the Pause Menu.
[*] Added new audio for the 4th level.
[*] Introduced a new tutorial system for gameplay mechanics.
[*] Adjusted star brightness in the second level.
[*] Standardized font for UI buttons in the main menu and the pause menu.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Critical Bug/Exploit:[/u] Players can no longer gain altitude by spamming the jump button when objects (even pee) are underneath the player.
[*] [u]Critical Bug:[/u] Fixed the Load/Save system for the Second Level (Twister). The level should now properly save and load when continued.
[*] Fixed the “clapping” audio in the final cinematic (4th Level - Space Lab).
[*] Fixed audio overlap in the first level after dying and respawning.
[*] Adjusted the activation range of the Question Console in the first level.
[*] Hid the body parts the second time Hans appears (4th level).
[*] Prevented audio from the poster-locker in the 4th level from being spammed.
[*] Created camera boundaries for the 1st level to prevent camera clipping.
[*] Changed the hitbox of the drawer and the key in the 4th level to make them easier to interact with.
[*] After completing the maggot task, it won’t be triggered again.
[*] Adjusted button colors in the UI (Pause Menu).
[*] Changed the Wheat-Collector display name from “Rice” to “Wheat”.
[*] The question board in the 1st level cannot be triggered again after completion.
[*] Bugs in the 4th level cannot be picked up before the maze puzzle is finished.
[*] The opening animation of the door in the first level cannot be canceled and retriggered.
[*] Added collision to the Blackboard.
[*] Player's position is now set next to the character after the 1st level cinematic.
[/list]

[b]Controller Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor changes include adding the “home” button to show the pause menu and separating the pickup and peeing inputs.
[/list]
Currently, we do NOT recommend using a controller as an input device. Future updates will overhaul the UI and add a control menu.
We are aware that the settings menu does not work as intended and it is a high priority on our list.

notes.title: Hotfix - File structure
notes.content:
We made an error while uploading Patch 1.0.0.1 by changing the file structure. There are two options to fix that problem. 
Either you repair you files (steam library/settings/installed data/check files integrity) 
or move all your data files (.../Steam/steamapps/common/Hans in the Internetz Playstest/Hans in the Internetz 1.0.0.1 ) to just (.../Steam/steamapps/common/Hans in the Internetz Playstest/). 

While patching, the folder "Hans in the Internetz 1.0.0.1" was a excess, that's why steam is not finding the path to the Hans_02.exe.

Fu** you & read you next time!
